title: Kagamine Len — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whether you already know me or not, a big hello to everyone out there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's nice! I like your energy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was going to just start singing, but since Rin did a self-introduction, I should probably do one too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like Rin already mentioned, we've been counting down to this day since about a month ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Every day, the moment the date changed, we'd play rock paper scissors and the winner got to cross out the previous day on the calendar.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Who crossed out the most dates?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think we were pretty evenly matched.
We'll go back and count them later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, I think the song's ready to go?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm just itching to start!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Here we go!
My first song will be...!
